thread:
leo (Eng): Quick one - my teammate in APAC has a national day that falls on our US company shutdown. Theyre in a different timezone and asked if they can swap it to the following Friday (same week) so they don't lose it.

mina (People Ops): short answer: probably yes. need manager approval + submit a Time-Off Exception in the portal. Deadline for it to affect year-end balances is 12/14.

arjun (Manager): I can approve. curious if there are any limits if multiple people in the same squad request the same swap?

mina (People Ops): rostering note: if >20% of a squad request the same replacement day we escalate for coverage plan. also contractors are treated differently (see payroll).

leo (Eng): teammate is full-time. i'll have them file the exception now.

paul (Payroll): payroll note: to ensure it shows on year-end, exception ID must be submitted to payroll by 12/15 cutoff. if late we'll still process but it will reflect on next cycle. also record the replacement as hours in WorkDay so our audit trails match.

leo (Eng): they submitted TOE-2026-998 and attached my approval screenshot.

mina (People Ops): received TOE-2026-998. routing to Payroll now. Mina -> Paul: forwarding the exception ID.

paul (Payroll): got it, queued for year-end close. tagging finance.

timebot: reminder scheduled for 12/10: confirm any timezone swap exceptions before payroll cutoff.

arjun (Manager): thanks all. resolved from my side.

mina (People Ops): closing thread. if more in APAC want this, please bundle requests so we can handle as a group exception. :white_check_mark:
